name: Ibuki Minamo
source: [url=/c7877]Tomoya[/url]'s kouhai who also attends the same school. Minamo has a lively personality, and also holds an interest in art. Due to her weak health, she has to constantly commute to hospitals. Minamo is also [url=/c7878]Ayaka[/url]'s younger cousin.
